premises.text: Day-to-day language barriers (work, doctor, etc.) are poorly served by machine translation alone
premises.evidence_span: we had A big problem with language barriers

premises.text: Crowdsourcing real-time human interpreters worldwide solves live language gaps
premises.evidence_span: it's crowdsourcing of real-time human interpreters all around the globe

premises.text: Interpreter profiles capture languages, levels, dialects/accents, expertise, and availability for matching
premises.evidence_span: we collect the dialects and the accents too

premises.text: A hybrid of professional and crowdsourced talent can cover nearly all spoken languages
premises.evidence_span: this is a hybrid crowdsource kind of solution

premises.text: Current product surfaces include live real-time video and conference interpreting
premises.evidence_span: a product for live video, live real-time video, and conferences

value.text: People can communicate in their native languages anywhere via on-demand human interpreters
value.evidence_span: you can travel anywhere in the world and be able to speak with anybody regardless of what language they speak

secondary_value.text: Crisis-response volunteer interpreting as an additional use of the network
secondary_value.evidence_span: we saw an opportunity for a use of Battleverse, which was crisis response

causal_links.evidence_span: there must be a better way than machine translation
crowdsourcing of real-time human interpreters all around the globe
product for live video, live real-time video, and conferences
